root_cause.text: In sca3000_probe(), the IRQ requested via request_threaded_irq() is not freed when iio_device_register() fails, causing a resource leak.
root_cause.evidence: The patch adds a return value check for iio_device_register() and jumps to the existing error_free_irq label to ensure the IRQ is released, as described in the commit message: "spi->irq from request_threaded_irq() not released when iio_device_register() fails."
